analysis.overview: The frames are operationally separate. Reference covers recurring family, access, health, scheduling, household, finance, travel, privacy, and accessibility context; Compared covers heat management and portable-fan use. Their limited fan and temperature overlap is thematic and does not establish a shared policy or decision.
